useCustomEnabled.description: When true, indicates that this virtual line uses the specified calling permissions for receiving inbound calls rather than the organizational defaults.

externalTransfer.description:
Specifies the transfer behavior for incoming, external calls.
 * `ALLOW_ALL_EXTERNAL` - Allow transfer and forward for all external calls including those which were transferred.
 * `ALLOW_ONLY_TRANSFERRED_EXTERNAL` - Only allow transferred calls to be transferred or forwarded and disallow transfer of other external calls.
 * `BLOCK_ALL_EXTERNAL` - Block all external calls from being transferred or forwarded.

internalCallsEnabled.description: Internal calls are allowed to be received.

collectCallsEnabled.description: Collect calls are allowed to be received.
